correctness.rationale: All hypotheses and quantifiers specified: integers m>=1, 1<=b<=2^m, binary affine truth tables ordered by integer. Least active bit gives pair-block decomposition. Adjacent pair-block zero mergers correspond bijectively to cyclic 1-to-0 transitions of a higher affine sequence. Binary carries yield an exact distribution j=ceil(v/2) with endpoint multiplicity 1 and interior 2, providing every coefficient of the enumerator. The affine coefficient partition is disjoint and exhaustive; constants treated separately. A separate brute-force enumerator verifies coefficient maps for m=1..8 and every b, plus boundary cases and derived pair spectrum. No inference from finite tests to the theorem.

value.rationale: Computes the full weight enumerator of a canonical family of affine/first-order RM codes in a natural physical cyclic-window channel for every block length and every read width; gives every coefficient rather than a routine minimum bound or a single test case. Shi et al. identify special-code b-symbol distributions as a research direction. The surprising uniform fourfold pair spectrum is a concrete structural consequence, and the proof supplies an all-parameter run-classification mechanism. Coordinate-order specificity is intrinsic to the b-symbol metric, not an arbitrary restriction.
